artifacts.notes: BDB hash/B-tree RPM headers from verified RAM bytes. Encrypted/checksummed BDB variants and transaction-log recovery are unsupported.
Gecko keys and inline/external Snappy structured clones decoded from verified RAM SQLite and scoped companion snapshots. Unsupported tags/object forms remain partial.
NDB version 0 only; validates indexed blobs and Adler32. No unreferenced/deleted package recovery.
SQLite Packages headers only; BDB remains raw. Inventory is not proof of execution.
Latest recorded login per username, not full session history.
Persisted snap state; stored revision and active flags are not execution evidence.
Deployment metadata; active deployment cannot be inferred from metadata presence alone.
Open/closed tab history and tab lastAccessed; no visit time inferred per entry. Decoded LZ4 safety limit is 64 MiB.
Bookmark snapshots, not evidence that a bookmarked URL was visited.
Stored permissions, not site-access evidence.

Verified physical LevelDB records, with Local/Session Storage fields and Chromium IndexedDB key/Blink/V8 object decoding. Unsupported tags and missing external blobs remain partial. Selected CURRENT/MANIFEST sets annotate latest acquired IndexedDB observations when validated; missing/changing sets remain unverified. No atomic live-process view.

Verified physical LevelDB records, with Local/Session Storage fields and Chromium IndexedDB key/Blink/V8 object decoding. Unsupported tags and missing external blobs remain partial. Selected CURRENT/MANIFEST sets annotate latest acquired IndexedDB observations when validated; missing/changing sets remain unverified. No atomic live-process view.
Local AES-IGE block decoding with selected key_data or supplied local key; recognized tagged draft schemas decoded. Unsupported inner schemas remain partial, never reported as sent chat history.
RAM-only binary keyring decoding with an empty or supplied known password. Wrong/missing passwords remain explicitly locked; no host keyring calls.
Classic Blowfish ECB/CBC and SHA1/PBKDF2 wallets. Modern wallets require their selected .salt companion. GPG wallets remain locked.
Key availability metadata only; selected configuration can provide a database key to the Signal message collector.

Read-only RAM parsing of plaintext SQLite or authenticated SQLCipher v3/v4 defaults, using the supplied raw key or a selected config.json key. Local version-2 authenticated attachments and legacy plaintext attachments are extracted within a 32 MiB aggregate payload budget. No host keyring or cloud access.

Physical policy lines only; effective privilege policy and include paths are not evaluated.
Public authorization keys; does not prove login. Unrecognized lines retained explicitly.
Stored trust entries can be added manually; hashed hosts are not resolved.
Stored configuration, not proof that a module or library loaded.
Autostart configuration; referenced commands are not run.
Stored scheduler dates, not a reliable session/execution boundary.

Remote access configuration is not proof of an active connection.
Manifest presence is not proof the extension was enabled.
Persisted pairing/configuration metadata does not establish connection time or current presence.
Protected; only readable files are acquired. Password hashes remain in raw evidence.
Directory-service caches require specialized parsers; do not equate local passwd with all accounts.
Launch commands are recorded, never executed.
BDB and ancillary RPM files retained raw; recognized SQLite/NDB inventories have narrower parser-backed definitions.
Offline key4 or legacy key3 NSS credential decoding with available profile keys and optional primary password. Unsupported/missing keys leave explicit locked records.
Linux v10/v11 CBC values decoded offline; v11 requires the supplied SafeStorage secret. Newer host-bound cookies require matching SHA-256 host prefix. Other platform encryption remains locked.
Linux v10/v11 CBC values decoded offline; v11 requires the supplied SafeStorage secret. Newer host-bound cookies require matching SHA-256 host prefix. Other platform encryption remains locked.
LevelDB, cache and session formats remain raw.
Traditional syslog dates lack a year/timezone; TERRA preserves them without inventing either.
Host libsystemd required. RAM snapshot preferred; if rejected, original source read-only and fully reverified. Sealing/integrity is not verified; unsupported/corrupt input retains raw evidence.
Supported layout: Linux little-endian 384-byte utmp. Other layouts fail explicitly.
Linux LE 292-byte layout only; other ABIs/byte orders are not guessed. UID comes from record offset, not host passwd. Latest login only.
Additional lastlog store variants retained raw; narrower recognized lastlog2 definitions take priority.
Timestamped multi-line entries are reconstructed; untimestamped history does not reliably preserve command boundaries.
Commands retain original fish escape sequences; no YAML tags or expressions are evaluated.
Only actual RFC mail/mbox stores are parsed; .msf indexes remain raw.

Optional pypff/libpff reads a RAM snapshot and extracts supported attachment bytes within a 32 MiB per-store derived budget. Without it, header metadata only. Deleted-item recovery and nested embedded-message interpretation remain unsupported.
